He even managed to come up with a new Firespray.''"<br />"''Well, I wasn't going to say anything, but I heard that that same bunch showed up to help liberate Ord Mantell.''"<br />"''And Tholatin.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Talon Karrde]], and [[Crev Bombaasa/Legends|Crev Bombaasa]]|<ref name="TUF" />}}
A '''battle''' at [[Tholatin]] was fought late in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. In the battle, the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] under the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] led by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] liberated the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tholatin]] from [[Yuuzhan Vong]] control.<ref name="TUF" />
